title: Death involving Taser under investigation
article: The province's Special Investigations Unit has been called in to investigate the death of a Brampton, Ont., man who died after being Tasered by police earlier this week.

Sean Reilly, 42, died Wednesday in a Brampton hospital after he was transferred there a day earlier. The SIU said Reilly was arrested at a Mississauga, Ont., home on Tuesday on a warrant for an outstanding assault with a weapon charge.
He was brought to a police division on Dixie Road, northwest of Toronto, at approximately 5 p.m., SIU spokesman John Yoannou said Thursday.

"Minutes after he was processed, a struggle ensued in the cell," Yoannou said. During the struggle, a conductive energy device was used on Reilly, causing him to go into "medical distress." Five police officers were involved in the incident.
"The man collapsed and he required immediate medical treatment," Yoannou said. "First aid and CPR were rendered."
